title: Sesame Place Philadelphia Admission Ticket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note: Tickets are only valid on selected date of travel.
Infants under the age of 2 years (1 year and 11 months) do not require admission. Proof of age such as a birth certificate may be required.
Strollers are available for rent or you may bring your own.
Outside food is not permitted with the exception of baby formula, snacks and medically necessary items. Picnic areas are available outside the park
Soft-sided coolers no larger than 10"x10"x12" are permitted
Water shoes are recommended. Swim suits, water shoes and swim diapers are available for purchase inside the park
Proper swim wear is required on all wet attractions
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Looking for a perfect all-day outing with the family? Enjoy ultimate family fun with whirling rides, splashy water slides, parades, shows, and more with your favorite Sesame Street friends at Sesame Place Philadelphia!

Just 30 minutes from Philadelphia, Sesame Place Philadelphia is the only theme park on the East Coast based entirely on the award-winning show, Sesame Street®, with more than 25 Sesame Street-themed attractions, entertaining character shows and parades, an interactive Sesame Street Neighborhood, and opportunities to meet everyone’s favorite furry friends!

Celebrate with seasonal events all year long, including Elmo’s Eggstravaganza, Elmo’s Springtacular, Sesame Summer Splash, The Count’s Halloween Spooktacular, and A Very Furry Christmas.

Sesame Place Philadelphia was the first theme park in the world to become a Certified Autism Center and was the first theme park in the United States to join the Hidden Disabilities Sunflower program.
